ask: this is a mess muse fix it
sentence: Tracks shared subscription bills in a chat, works out who owes whom, suggests the fewest payments to settle up, and lets each person mark their own payment as paid.
use_when: A group shares streaming, wifi or other recurring subscriptions and wants to know who owes what
One person paid a bill and others need to pay them back
Some people want to skip a bill they do not use
The group wants a short list of payments to settle up
dont_use_when: Splitting a one-off meal or trip bill with uneven custom amounts per person
Collecting money in advance toward a shared goal or gift
Actually sending money, since this only records payments people say they made
